products.product_description: Silk Soymilk Vanilla Bag-In-Box. One, 2.5 gallon bag per box. 2.5 gal Bag-In-Box to be used in a dispensing machine at foodservice & convenience outlets.
products.reason_for_recall: Mislabeled outer box of Silk Soymilk Vanilla Bag-In-Box. Outer box incorrectly indicates the product is almond milk instead of soymilk. The internal product in box is labeled correctly as Silk Soymilk Vanilla Bag-In-Box.
